result.title: Decoupling Solving from Abstention: Single-Rollout Conformal Risk Control for Hard-Budget LLM Reasoning
result.summary: Hard token budgets often interrupt LLM reasoning before an answer is produced. Forcing reasoning to terminate recovers correct solutions but also increases confident errors, creating a joint challenge of solving within budget and deciding when to abstain. Existing remedies are costly or lack guarantees: supervised fine-tuning offers no error control, penalizing wrong answers during reinforcement learning (RL) can suppress exploration, and multi-sample conformal methods multiply inference cost. We propose Tail-CRC, a single-rollout framework that separates candidate generation from submission control. We first adapt the solver to budget forcing with pure binary correctness rewards; after freezing it, we apply conformal risk control to upper-tail token surprise in the answer span. Each rollout yields both an answer and an uncertainty score from token log probabilities, enabling finite-sample control of expected wrong submissions under exchangeability and recalibration across risk targets or domains without retraining. We show that wrong-answer penalties create failure-only comparisons in group-relative RL, derive an exploration-starvation boundary, and identify length-induced ranking reversals and single-token spike sensitivity in answer scores. Across Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3-8B, 50 RL updates on 400 problems improve correct-submission rates by 15.0--29.6 points on DAPO and 4.3--12.8 points on out-of-domain Omni-MATH over inference-only budget forcing, while reducing generation cost by 3.5--12.6\%. On 8B Omni-MATH, target-domain calibration cuts wrong submissions from 30.3\% to 5.8\% at 4K and from 41.8\% to 6.5\% at 8K. At 4K, generation is 2.05$\times$ faster for 4B and 2.23$\times$ faster for 8B than unforced 8K decoding in local amortized batch time. Tail-CRC thus enables reliable, efficient budgeted reasoning from a single rollout.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Tail-CRC：先用纯二值正确性奖励的 RL 让求解器适应硬 token 预算强制，冻结后用 conformal risk control 约束答案片段 token surprise 的上尾，使单次 rollout 同时给出答案与不确定性分数并控制错误提交率。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接触及 STOP 一侧的停止与弃答决策及其计算成本收益，其单次采样的上尾校准弃答规则可供核查迁移为 VLM 推理的停止判据；但对象为纯文本数学推理，不含视觉证据筛选。
